text_en: After this Jesus went to the other side of the Sea of Galilee, also called the Sea of Tiberias.
text_cn: 这些事以后，耶稣往加里肋亚海，即提庇黎雅海的对岸去了。

text_en: A large crowd kept following him, because they saw the signs that he was doing for the sick.
text_cn: 大批群众，因为看见他在患病者身上所行的神迹，都跟随着他。

text_en: Jesus went up the mountain and sat down there with his disciples.
text_cn: 耶稣上了山，和他的门徒一起坐在那里。

text_en: Now the Passover, the festival of the Jews, was near.
text_cn: 那时，犹太人的庆节，即逾越节，已临近了。

text_en: When he looked up and saw a large crowd coming toward him, Jesus said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread for these people to eat? ”
text_cn: 耶稣举目看见大批群众来到他前，就对斐理伯说：“我们从哪里买饼给这些人吃呢？”

text_en: He said this to test him, for he himself knew what he was going to do.
text_cn: 他说这话，是为试探斐理伯；他自己原知道要作什么。

text_en: Philip answered him, “Six months’ wages would not buy enough bread for each of them to get a little. ”
text_cn: 斐理伯回答说：“就是二百块‘德纳’的饼，也不够每人分得一小块。”

text_en: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,
text_cn: 有一个门徒，即西满伯多禄的哥哥安德肋说：

text_en: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish. But what are they among so many people? ”
text_cn: “这里有一个儿童，他有五个大麦饼和两条鱼；但是为这么多的人这算得什么？”

text_en: Jesus said, “Make the people sit down. ” Now there was a great deal of grass in the place; so they sat down, about five thousand in all.
text_cn: 耶稣说：“你们叫众人坐下罢！”在那地方有许多青草，于是人们便坐下，男人约有五千。

text_en: Then Jesus took the loaves, and when he had given thanks, he distributed them to those who were seated; so also the fish, as much as they wanted.
text_cn: 耶稣就拿起饼，祝谢后，分给坐下的人；对于鱼也照样作了；让众人任意吃。

text_en: When they were satisfied, he told his disciples, “Gather up the fragments left over, so that nothing may be lost. ”
text_cn: 他们吃饱以后，耶稣向门徒说：“把剩下的碎块收集起来，免得蹧蹋了。”

text_en: So they gathered them up, and from the fragments of the five barley loaves, left by those who had eaten, they filled twelve baskets.
text_cn: 他们就把人吃后所剩下的五个大麦饼的碎块，收集起来，装满了十二筐。

text_en: When the people saw the sign that he had done, they began to say, “This is indeed the prophet who is to come into the world. ”
text_cn: 众人见了耶稣所行的神迹，就说：“这人确实是那要来到世界上的先知。”

text_en: When Jesus realized that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, he withdrew again to the mountain by himself.
text_cn: 耶稣看出他们要来强迫他，立他为王，就独自又退避到山里去了。

text_en: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea,
text_cn: 到了晚上，他的门徒下到海边，

text_en: got into a boat, and started across the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not yet come to them.
text_cn: 上船要到海对岸的葛法翁去。天已黑了，耶稣还没有来到他们那里。

text_en: The sea became rough because a strong wind was blowing.
text_cn: 海上因起了大风，便翻腾起来。

text_en: When they had rowed about three or four miles, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and coming near the boat, and they were terrified.
text_cn: 当他们摇橹大约过了二十五或三十“斯塔狄”时，看见耶稣在海面上行走，临近了船，便害怕起来。

text_en: But he said to them, “It is I; do not be afraid. ”
text_cn: 但他却向他们说：“是我，不要害怕！”

text_en: Then they wanted to take him into the boat, and immediately the boat reached the land toward which they were going.
text_cn: 他们便欣然接他上船，船就立时到了他们所要去的地方。

text_en: The next day the crowd that had stayed on the other side of the sea saw that there had been only one boat there. They also saw that Jesus had not got into the boat with his disciples, but that his disciples had gone away alone.
text_cn: 第二天，留在海对岸的群众，看见只有一只小船留在那里，也知道耶稣没有同他的门徒一起上船，只有他的门徒走了──

text_en: Then some boats from Tiberias came near the place where they had eaten the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
text_cn: 然而从提庇黎雅有别的小船来到了，靠近吾主祝谢后，人们吃饼的地方──

text_en: So when the crowd saw that neither Jesus nor his disciples were there, they themselves got into the boats and went to Capernaum looking for Jesus.
text_cn: 当群众一发觉耶稣和他的门徒都不在那里时，他们便上了那些小船，往葛法翁找耶稣去了。

text_en: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they said to him, “Rabbi, when did you come here? ”
text_cn: 当群众在海对岸找着他时，就对他说：“辣彼，你什么时候到了这里？”

text_en: Jesus answered them, “Very truly, I tell you, you are looking for me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate your fill of the loaves.
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“我实实在在告诉你们：你们寻找我，并不是因为看到了神迹，而是因为吃饼吃饱了。

text_en: Do not work for the food that perishes, but for the food that endures for eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For it is on him that God the Father has set his seal. ”
text_cn: 你们不要为那可损坏的食粮劳碌，而要为那存留到永生的食粮劳碌，即人子所要赐给你们的，因为他是天主圣父所印证的。”

text_en: Then they said to him, “What must we do to perform the works of God? ”
text_cn: 他们问说：“我们该做什么，才算做天主的事业呢？”

text_en: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent. ”
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“天主要你们所做的事业，就是要你们信从他所派遣来的。”

text_en: So they said to him, “What sign are you going to give us then, so that we may see it and believe you? What work are you performing?
text_cn: 他们又说：“那么，你行什么神迹给我们看，好叫我们信服你呢？你要行什么事呢？

text_en: Our ancestors ate the manna in the wilderness; as it is written, ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat. ’”
text_cn: 我们的祖先在旷野里吃过“玛纳”正如经上所记载的：‘他从天上赐给了他们食物吃。’”

text_en: Then Jesus said to them, “Very truly, I tell you, it was not Moses who gave you the bread from heaven, but it is my Father who gives you the true bread from heaven.
text_cn: 于是耶稣向他们说：“我实实在在告诉你们：并不是梅瑟赐给了你们那从天上来的食粮，而是我父现今赐给你们从天上来的真正的食粮，

text_en: For the bread of God is that which comes down from heaven and gives life to the world. ”
text_cn: 因为天主的食粮，是那由天降下，并赐给世界生命的。”

text_en: They said to him, “Sir, give us this bread always. ”
text_cn: 他们便说：“主！你就把这样的食粮常常赐给我们罢！”

text_en: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“我就是生命的食粮；到我这里来的，永不会饥饿；信从我的，总不会渴。

text_en: But I said to you that you have seen me and yet do not believe.
text_cn: 但是，我向你们说过：你们看见了我，仍然不信。

text_en: Everything that the Father gives me will come to me, and anyone who comes to me I will never drive away;
text_cn: 凡父交给我的，必到我这里来；而到我这里来的，我必不把他抛弃于外，

text_en: for I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.
text_cn: 因为我从天降下，不是为执行我的旨意，而是为执行派遣我来者的旨意。

text_en: And this is the will of him who sent me, that I should lose nothing of all that he has given me, but raise it up on the last day.
text_cn: 派遣我来者的旨意就是：凡他交给我的，叫我连一个也不失掉，而且在末日还要使他复活，

text_en: This is indeed the will of my Father, that all who see the Son and believe in him may have eternal life; and I will raise them up on the last day. ”
text_cn: 因为这是我父的旨意：凡看见子，并信从子的，必获得永生；并且在末日，我要使他复活。”

text_en: Then the Jews began to complain about him because he said, “I am the bread that came down from heaven. ”
text_cn: 犹太人遂对耶稣窃窃私议，因为他说：我是从天上降下来的食粮。

text_en: They were saying, “Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How can he now say, ‘I have come down from heaven’? ”
text_cn: 他们说：“这人不是若瑟的儿子耶稣么？他的父亲和母亲，我们岂不是都认识么？怎么他竟说：我是从天上降下来的呢？”

text_en: Jesus answered them, “Do not complain among yourselves.
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“你们不要彼此窃窃私议！

text_en: No one can come to me unless drawn by the Father who sent me; and I will raise that person up on the last day.
text_cn: 凡不是派遣我的父所吸引的人，谁也不能到我这里来，而我在末日要叫他复活。

text_en: It is written in the prophets, ‘And they shall all be taught by God. ’ Everyone who has heard and learned from the Father comes to me.
text_cn: 在《先知书》上记载：‘众人都要蒙天主的训诲。’凡由父听教而学习的，必到我这里来。

text_en: Not that anyone has seen the Father except the one who is from God; he has seen the Father.
text_cn: 这不是说有人看见过父，只有那从天主来的，才看见过父。

text_en: Very truly, I tell you, whoever believes has eternal life.
text_cn: 我实实在在告诉你们：信从的人，必得永生。

text_en: I am the bread of life.
text_cn: 我是生命的食粮。

text_en: Your ancestors ate the manna in the wilderness, and they died.
text_cn: 你们的祖先在旷野中吃过‘玛纳’却死了；

text_en: This is the bread that comes down from heaven, so that one may eat of it and not die.
text_cn: 这是从天上降下来的食粮，谁吃了，就不死。

text_en: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. Whoever eats of this bread will live forever; and the bread that I will give for the life of the world is my flesh. ”
text_cn: 我是从天上降下的生活的食粮；谁若吃了这食粮，必要生活直到永远。”“我所要赐给的食粮，就是我的肉，是为世界的生命而赐给的。”

text_en: The Jews then disputed among themselves, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat? ”
text_cn: 因此，犹太人彼此争论说：“这人怎能把他的肉，赐给我们吃呢？”

text_en: So Jesus said to them, “Very truly, I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you have no life in you.
text_cn: 耶稣向他们说：“我实实在在告诉你们：你们若不吃人子的肉，不喝他的血，在你们内，便没有生命。

text_en: Those who eat my flesh and drink my blood have eternal life, and I will raise them up on the last day;
text_cn: 谁吃我的肉，并喝我的血，必得永生，在末日，我且要叫他复活，

text_en: for my flesh is true food and my blood is true drink.
text_cn: 因为我的肉，是真实的食品；我的血，是真实的饮料。

text_en: Those who eat my flesh and drink my blood abide in me, and I in them.
text_cn: 谁吃我的肉，并喝我的血，便住在我内，我也住在他内。

text_en: Just as the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father, so whoever eats me will live because of me.
text_cn: 就如那生活的父派遣了我，我因父而生活；照样，那吃我的人，也要因我而生活。

text_en: This is the bread that came down from heaven, not like that which your ancestors ate, and they died. But the one who eats this bread will live forever. ”
text_cn: 这是从天上降下来的食粮，不像祖先吃了‘玛纳’仍然死了；谁吃这食粮，必要生活直到永远。”

text_en: He said these things while he was teaching in the synagogue at Capernaum.
text_cn: 这些话是耶稣在葛法翁会堂教训人时说的。

text_en: When many of his disciples heard it, they said, “This teaching is difficult; who can accept it? ”
text_cn: 他的门徒中有许多听了，便说：“这话生硬，谁能听得下去呢？”

text_en: But Jesus, being aware that his disciples were complaining about it, said to them, “Does this offend you?
text_cn: 耶稣自知他的门徒对这话窃窃私议，便向他们说：“这话使你们起反感吗？

text_en: Then what if you were to see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?
text_cn: 那么，如果你们看到人子升到他先前所在的地方去，将怎样呢？

text_en: It is the spirit that gives life; the flesh is useless. The words that I have spoken to you are spirit and life.
text_cn: 使生活的是神，肉一无所用；我给你们所讲论的话，就是神，就是生命。

text_en: But among you there are some who do not believe. ” For Jesus knew from the first who were the ones that did not believe, and who was the one that would betray him.
text_cn: 但你们中间有些人，却不相信”。原来，耶稣从起头就知道那些人不信，和谁要出卖他。

text_en: And he said, “For this reason I have told you that no one can come to me unless it is granted by the Father. ”
text_cn: 所以他又说：“为此，我对你们说过：除非蒙父恩赐的，谁也不能到我这里来。”

text_en: Because of this many of his disciples turned back and no longer went about with him.
text_cn: 从此，他的门徒中有许多人退去了，不再同他往来。

text_en: So Jesus asked the twelve, “Do you also wish to go away? ”
text_cn: 于是耶稣向那十二人说：“难道你们也愿走吗？”

text_en: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom can we go? You have the words of eternal life.
text_cn: 西满伯多禄回答说：“主！惟你有永生的话，我们去投奔谁呢？

text_en: We have come to believe and know that you are the Holy One of God. ”
text_cn: 我们相信，而且已知道你是天主的圣者。”

text_en: Jesus answered them, “Did I not choose you, the twelve? Yet one of you is a devil. ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“我不是拣选了你们十二个人吗？你们中却有一个是魔鬼。”

text_en: He was speaking of Judas son of Simon Iscariot, for he, though one of the twelve, was going to betray him.
text_cn: 他是指依斯加略人西满的儿子犹达斯说的；因为就是这人，十二人中的一个，将要出卖耶稣。
